thread:
Mia: Heads-up — Customer 'BrightLoom' is asking to onboard Nova-70B (fp16) into Dedicated for low-latency production. They want quantized variants and a staged rollout.

Sam: Thanks — do we have perf targets from them? latency / qps / cost envelope?

Mia: Customer emailed: 95th perc latency < 250ms for 1k tokens, steady qps 40, peak bursts to 200 for a few minutes. Budget is ~40% of current Llama-70B per-token spend.

Jordan: Got it. That sounds tight. We should list immediate blockers: model artifacts, tokenizer compatibility, KF-aware quant recipe, and eval prompts.

Ellen: Suggest initial triage plan: quick smoke (fp16) -> 8-bit quant (gptq/awq) -> RLHF-style quality checks. Also need license check for Nova weights.

Mia: Agreed. Can someone kick off artifact validation + license? I can handle eval design.

Sam: I’ll take artifact + tokenizer validation. Steps I’ll run: 1) sha256 verify artifacts, 2) tokenizer roundtrip tests on subset, 3) model config sanity (vocab size, KV cache).

Jordan: I’ll prototype a quantization run with awq 4-bit out-of-the-box on a single A100 and report memory/throughput. Expect 2–3 hrs.

Mia: For evals: short prompt suite (50 prompts) focused on instruction-following, hallucination checks, and safety filters. We should also include the customer’s domain-specific prompts (e-commerce chatflow).

Ellen: Can we add an automated regression threshold? e.g., pass if avg EM drop <= 2% vs fp16 baseline and no >5% failure on safety checks.

Jordan: +1. I’ll produce baseline metrics (fp16). Then quant variants and compare.

onboard-bot: New onboarding ticket created: #ONB-7523 (Nova-70B — BrightLoom). Assigned: Sam, Jordan, Mia. Due: 3 business days for initial smoke.

Mia: Quick checklist for this thread (copying into ticket):
- [ ] Artifact & license verification (Sam)
- [ ] Tokenizer roundtrip / unit tests (Sam)
- [ ] FP16 smoke serve + latency baseline (Jordan)
- [ ] 4-bit AWQ quant prototype (Jordan)
- [ ] Eval set creation, include customer prompts (Mia)
- [ ] Regression thresholds & gating (Ellen)
- [ ] Production rollout policy (canary -> linear) + fallback plan (Mia)
- [ ] Cost forecast (ops) and Dedicated sizing (Kevin)

Kevin: I’ll run capacity calc after Jordan shares baseline. Also need to know whether they want prefix caching enabled and their expected token length distribution.

Mia: Customer says avg request 120 tokens, 95th 850 tokens. Prefix caching should help for multi-turn.

Sam: Found a minor tokenizer mismatch: special token ordering different from our standard detokenizer. Patching locally, re-running small test.

Jordan: FP16 smoke done on A100-80G: at 120 tokens median latency 190ms, 95th 260ms — slightly over target. QPS single replica ~45. Uploading logs to ticket.

Mia: Good data. Next: run AWQ 4-bit and measure token throughput & any quality delta. If 4-bit meets regression thresholds, we can meet cost target; otherwise try q4_k_m or 6-bit hybrid.

Ellen: QA-bot: scheduled automated safety sweep after quant variants land. Test groups: toxic generation, PII leakage, hallucination triggers.

Sam: Licensing: Nova license allows commercial hosted usage but requires attribution metadata in user-facing docs. Flagging legal for confirmation.

Mia: Plan to have a canary in Dedicated for 48 hours, monitor token-level cost and 95th latency SLO, rollback on >10% latency climb or >3% quality regression.

Jordan: Starting AWQ run now. Will post summary + perf table once finished.

Kevin: Noted. I’ll pre-provision one additional GPU node for canary capacity so we can hit burst targets without affecting other tenants.

Mia: Thanks team — next update in thread when Jordan posts quant summary. If anyone spots a risk that blocks the 3-day smoke SLA, ping immediately. :thumbsup:
